description: Triggers when the user says「批量修复」「批量 jira-fix」「jira-fix-queue」「jira-fix-batch」「批量修复多个 Jira」「批量修复以下 bug」/ batch fix, batch jira-fix, jira-fix-queue, jira-fix-batch.
